newsitem.title: USA: USG says conditions met to buy rest of Canada firm.
newsitem.headline: USG says conditions met to buy rest of Canada firm.

text.p: USG Corp said on Tuesday that that minimum tender and other conditions have been met for the offer by Canada Inc, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of USG, to buy the common shares of CGC Inc that it does not already own for C$11 per share.
USG already owned about 76 percent of the Canadian gypsum wallboard company before the October 31 offer, the companies have said.
Some 5.3 million CGC common shares representing nearly 88 percent of outstanding common shares not already owned by USG were tendered before the offer expired December 2, USG said.

The offer has been extended until late afternoon on December 13, when USG intends to buy the remaining shares if it has acquired 90 percent of CGC common shares that it does not already own, the company said.
